notes.title: 🆕 V0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The V0.6 update introduces a new feature and several important bug fixes:
✨ New Feature
Crosshair Cursor Smoothing: When using external light gun hardware, the crosshair could jitter due to excessive sensitivity. A smoothing system has now been added to improve stability.

Smoothing Adjustment:

Press , to increase smoothing for more stability.

Press . to decrease smoothing for higher precision when using a mouse.
🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where spiders could get stuck at the cave exit respawn point.

Fixed a bug where the reload sound could not be stopped.

Fixed an issue where some fonts were not displaying correctly.

notes.title: 🎯Demo Official Guide – BloodStorm: AlienPurge
notes.content:
🎯 Demo Official Guide – BloodStorm: AlienPurge[hr][/hr]📖 Basic Controls
Pistol
    
Single-shot, fast reload speed
    

Magazine: 8 rounds
    

Ammo Reserve: Unlimited
    

✨ Main weapon throughout the game; skilled players can clear the game using only the pistol.
    


Rifle
    
Automatic fire, high DPS
    

Magazine: 30 rounds
    

Ammo must be collected during gameplay
    

⚡ Slower reload; recommended for heavy battles and boss fights.
    


[img src=""]
[hr][/hr]🧩 Core Gameplay Mechanics🎯 Weak Spot System
Each monster has a designated weak point.


Hitting the weak spot deals double damage and doubles your score.


Example: Big-Eyed Monsters' weak point is their eyeball, but they frequently blink to protect it. Different variants blink differently.

⚡ Attack Wind-up and Stagger Mechanics
Most monsters have a clear attack wind-up animation.


Stronger monsters have shorter wind-ups, requiring faster reactions.


Tip: Interrupt or kill enemies before their attack completes!

🔥 QTE Dodge System
Floating targets labeled L1, L2, R1, R2 appear during combat.


Shoot the correct sequence according to:
    
Enemy attack direction
    

Your current position (e.g., avoid dodging toward walls)
    


Mistakes will cause HP loss or instant defeat.

🕵️ Stay Sharp: Observation, Judgment, Reaction
Observe enemy spawn locations and movements carefully.


Manage ammo wisely — do not blindly empty your magazine.


Prioritize interrupting enemies about to attack.


Mastering this means you can clear the game with the pistol only!

[hr][/hr]👾 Demo Version – Monster Overview
Big-Eyed Scythe Soldier
    
Low HP
    

Close-range attacks
    

Long attack wind-up
    


Big-Eyed Axe Thrower
    
Low HP
    

Throws axes at moderate speed
    


Big-Eyed Barrel Thrower
    
Throws explosive barrels
    

Massive damage if barrels are not destroyed mid-air
    


Big-Eyed Shuriken Thrower
    
Throws fast-moving shuriken
    

Easier to destroy than axes, but much faster
    


Big-Eyed Spearman
    
Fast charge attacks
    

Short attack wind-up
    


Ironclad Big-Eyed Boss
    
Heavy armor + giant iron axe
    

Can one-shot kill the player
    

Must break its armor to stagger it
    

Summons other enemy types during battle
    

[hr][/hr]📢 Final Reminder
Stay calm, observe enemy patterns.


Always manage your ammo and reloads strategically.


Remember: True agents rely not just on firepower, but on superior intelligence and reflexes!
